kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتشرذم (form IIq)
# نَتَشَرْذَمُ (natašarḏamu) /na.ta.ʃar.ða.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# نَتَشَرْذَمَ (natašarḏama) /na.ta.ʃar.ða.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# نَتَشَرْذَمْ (natašarḏam) /na.ta.ʃar.ðam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
